data.rationale: The proposed workflow follows the same sequence and parameters (case, statute): CourtListener search, opinion citation and date, Cornell LII statute lookup, then a note in Notes. It leaves out the new-tab and close-tab handling, the "New note" click and the Enter keypress, and it vaguely says "title" for the section heading, so a browser automation would need to fill in those details.
